content_sections.heading: Punjabi University Patiala Guest Faculty (Vocal Music) Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the Punjabi University Patiala Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download Punjabi University Patiala Guest Faculty (Vocal Music) Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Master's degree in Vocal Music with NET/PhD or equivalent

content_sections.heading: Salary/ Stipend
content_sections.text: Guest Faculty (Vocal Music): Rs. 30,000/- (for NET/PhD candidates) or Rs. 22,000/- per month.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Punjabi University Patiala Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Punjabi University Patiala for filling up academic positions at their campus.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised under this notification?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Guest Faculty (Vocal Music) under advertisement number UCCK/2186/2026.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Guest Faculty (Vocal Music) position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process consists of a Walk-in Interview followed by document verification on the scheduled date.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to take place on 05-10-2026. Candidates must report on time.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Vocal Music with NET, PhD, or equivalent qualifications.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary ranging between Rs. 22,000 and Rs. 30,000 per month depending on qualifications.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for candidates belonging to General, OBC, SC, or ST categories.

faq.question: Q9. Do I need to apply online before attending the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: No prior online application is required; eligible candidates can directly attend the walk-in interview at the designated venue.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original educational and identity documents along with a set of self-attested photocopies and photographs.
